name: pickAttachmentFiles
description: Open the native OS file-open dialog (multi-select, modal to the Nexus browser window) so the user can attach files to the composer. The guest <webview> cannot raise its own <input type=file> chooser, so the composer's paperclip button routes here instead (mirrors pickProjectFolder). Resolves with { paths, canceled }: `paths` is the array of chosen absolute file paths (empty when canceled), `canceled` is true iff the dialog was dismissed without a selection. Test seam: when the NEXUS_E2E_ATTACHMENT_FILES environment variable is set and non-empty, the handler resolves with those paths (newline-separated) WITHOUT showing a dialog (Playwright cannot drive a native OS dialog).

inputs.name: extensions
inputs.description: Optional allowed file extensions (without the leading dot, e.g. "png", "ts"). When non-empty the dialog offers a matching filter group alongside an always-present "All files" option; when omitted or empty the dialog allows any file. The composer adapter re-validates each picked file against its accept list, so this is a UX hint, not an enforced gate.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Optional dialog title. Falls back to the platform default when omitted or empty.
